summary: Implemented the Admin account reports, report details, and account restrictions surfaces for ADM-06, ADM-07, and ADM-08 using the implemented account-report moderation and account-transition contracts. The UI keeps projections safe, requires reasons for sensitive actions, consumes server-provided account actions, supports loading/empty/error/retry/success/not-found/permission states, and renders Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR on the approved desktop scope.

The account-report API and contracts were repaired and closed under backend_019 before this task; frontend_062 consumes those implemented contracts and does not change them.
Admin navigation remains anchored to the existing Users and accounts section because the selected task's approved route composition uses the existing admin navigation boundary.
The approved design manifest defines ADM-06 through ADM-08 as desktop-only; Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese direction/locale coverage was verified in the desktop matrix.
No real .env, secret, production data, live database, or external provider credential was read or used.
